svg.title: Guaranteed delivery: the sender journals the guaranteed packs between the positions base, acked, sent and next, capped at resumable_megabytes; unmarked packs bypass the journal. Packs carry no extra bytes; a control record between two packs carries REPORT, CONTINUE or LOST with a 62-bit position. The receiver position stands at the end of the last whole guaranteed pack.
